# PickMe — AI Product Visibility Lab

PickMe evaluates whether an ecommerce product is visible and well-ranked for a
buyer intent. It uses a fictional Shopwise catalog containing five complete
Amazon Fashion records.

## Entry points

- Evaluation workspace: /
- OpenAI evaluation endpoint: POST /api/evaluate
- Storefront: /shop
- Editable browsing journey: /shop/journey
- Machine-readable catalog: /shop/catalog.json
- Sitemap: /sitemap.xml

## Product routes

Each product uses an Amazon-style route:

    /shop/dp/{parent_asin}

Product pages include semantic headings, product details, prices, ratings,
features, image alt text, and Product JSON-LD. The journey editor stores its
ordered ASIN sequence in the shareable `path` query parameter.

The evaluation endpoint accepts `productUrl`, `intent`, and an optional
`productDraft`. It returns adversarial query tests, a five-product leaderboard,
a discovery plan, four 25-point metrics, and grounded metadata fixes. The
OpenAI API key remains server-side.

This is a demo. Cart and checkout actions do not process real orders.
